reasoning_content: The previous install finished (with a prepare failure). Now that Java is installed, let me rerun `pnpm install` (node_modules is nearly in place, the store is warm, so only the prepare step and linking remain).

action.command:
cd /workspace/app && nohup pnpm install --trust-lockfile --network-concurrency 10 --fetch-timeout 120000 --fetch-retries 5 --fetch-retry-mintimeout 2000 --fetch-retry-maxtimeout 60000 > /tmp/pnpm-install2.log 2>&1 &
echo "reinstall pid $!"; sleep 30; tail -4 /tmp/pnpm-install2.log
